card.name: Pointers to reading the full document
card.fires_on: The word that completes a pointer to a governing document, such as "conditions" in "Terms and conditions", "Information" in "Full Prescribing Information", or "reading" before "the Medication Guide".

modes.label: Full Prescribing Information
modes.description: "Information" ends the phrase telling the reader to refer to the Full Prescribing Information.
modes.example: Refer to the Full Prescribing<< Information>> for ribociclib.

modes.label: Reading the Medication Guide
modes.description: "reading" comes just before the Medication Guide in REMS counseling text.
modes.example: safe use, and the importance of<< reading>> the Medication Guide with each prescription.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words naming official documents, such as manuals, rules, clauses and FAQs.
card.plain: It marks the spot where text tells you to go read the full instructions, guide or terms.
